purpose: Time 时钟; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandTime](../../lib/src/components/time.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Instance-owned refresh timer (clock refresh and colon blink), injected wall clock, no per-tick live announcement.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality. Weekday and month-day text follow weekdayFormat (default dddd) and dateFormat (default MMM D, or M月D日 under IslandTimeLocale.zhCn) in core date tokens with English or Simplified Chinese names; the per-instance locale changes no global state.
interface.async_behavior: Owner-local 500ms refresh timer also steps the decorative colon blink (reference animal-time-blink 1s step-end: visible then hidden for half a second each second); digits never dim, semantics keep the complete clock, and reduced motion keeps the colon visible. No second timer. Opaque entry uses modest displacement (4px) on the reference .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) timing and reduced motion settles the same wrapper.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

Normal: the #f8f8f0 card (20px radius, 20/32/15 padding, soft shadow) with the 44px/900 #836b4e clock (reference #8b7355 deepened to 4.5:1) above one teal capsule holding the upper-cased weekday · month-day. Game (reference 4.0.0): no card, shadow or radius; 50px padding; 40px/900 clock with 2px letter-spacing in the same ink (#b59c7c on dark hosts) and its colon 1px apart, raised .08em; 8px below, a decorative 2px rgba(159,146,125,.35) rule with 2px radius spanning the content width plus 5px (2.5px overhang each side); 5px below, the 22px/800/2px-spaced month-day and, 20px to its right, the weekday (15px/900, line-height 1, not upper-cased) in a #fffbe7 capsule padded 7/16/5. Both variants share one entrance, colon blink, timer and semantics.
Defaults show Monday / Jun 8 (card: MONDAY); zhCn shows 星期一 / 6月8日; ddd + YYYY/MM/DD shows Mon / 2026/06/08; zhCn + ddd shows 周一; [text] renders literally.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: Necessary content on its actual supporting surface, including reduced-motion changes
scenarios.when: Enter, sample intermediate frames, reverse/reopen, close, cancel and unmount
scenarios.then: Content/backing stay readable; one subtree retains state; hit/focus/semantics track availability; no stale timer or duplicate callback. Approved reference deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md.
